question: What does the Agreed Value Endorsement (CA-33) apply to — total losses only or also partial losses?
answer: The Agreed Value Endorsement (CA-33) applies only to total losses. In the event of a total loss to the covered vehicle, the insurer will pay the Agreed Value shown in the Schedule, minus the applicable deductible, instead of actual cash value. The Agreed Value does not apply to partial (repairable) losses; partial losses remain subject to the standard Limit of Liability provision of Part D [1].

We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto, including its equipment, minus any applicable deductible shown on the
